snippet.title: Observer Protocol: The Station - First Shift // Trailer
snippet.description:
Play the Game ► https://store.steampowered.com/app/3765880/Observer_Protocol_The_Station__First_Shift

A minimalist surveillance horror game. Flip through security cameras on a deep space station and report subtle anomalies. No jump scares. No combat. Just watch, observe, and try not to miss the moment everything goes wrong.

Developed by
BuderWorks
